title: plan_ops__gates input
description: Run the six canonical phase gates (schema-valid, schedule-valid, fixture-valid, execution-safe, review-safe, commit-safe) either individually (--check) or as a dry-run/execute certification bundle (--certify).

list.description: Emit the canonical list of gate names

check.description: Comma-separated gate names to evaluate; fails with exit 1 if any checked gate returns status=fail

certify.description: Certify the promotion bundle for --mode (dry-run|execute); exit 1 if any required gate in the bundle returns status=fail

mode.description: Required with --certify; selects the promotion bundle

plan_file.description: Path to plan markdown file (for schema-valid/fixture-valid)

schedule_file.description: Path to schedule JSON file (for schedule-valid)

commit_sha.description: Commit SHA to inspect for commit-safe

task_id.description: Task id whose Files: list scopes commit-safe allowed paths

run_id.description: Run identifier for certify-execute commit-safe verification
